judged_text: With credential sharing enabled the awaited value is a raw fetch Response but it is annotated and consumed as HubspotToken, so hubspotRefreshToken.access_token and every other token field is undefined. The unchanged code below spreads this value into the persisted credential key, so the stored Hubspot credential is overwritten without access_token/refresh_token and the integration is permanently broken after the first refresh under sharing mode.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it does a `fetch(...)` and **returns the raw `Response` object** (no `.json()` parsing). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then (per the existing refresh flow) will treat it as a token object (e.g., `hubspotRefreshToken.access_token`, spreading into stored credential key). Under sharing mode, that value will be a `Response`, so token fields will be `undefined` and the credential update logic would overwrite stored keys with missing token data, breaking the integration after a refresh.
